summary.text: Andy Kim is a U.S. Senator from New Jersey and serves on the Banking, Commerce, Homeland Security, HELP, and Aging committees.

paragraphs.text: He represented a New Jersey district in the U.S. House of Representatives from 2019 to 2024.
According to his Senate website, he is the son of Korean immigrants and was raised in South Jersey.
Before Congress he was a career public servant at USAID, the Pentagon, the State Department and the White House National Security Council, and a civilian advisor to generals in Afghanistan.
